description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Cotiviti develops customer-facing healthcare analytics applications. The Associate Software Engineer helps deliver projects by designing and implementing solutions, supporting analytics systems, reviewing code, and collaborating with developers and business stakeholders.
Associate Software Engineer developing and supporting analytics systems, designing solutions and reviewing software changes

Responsibilities:
• Work within the team developing and supporting analytics systems with patent pending technology and applications to support our in-house audit partners
• Design and implement new solutions
• Learn new technologies and apply them to the problem space
• Peer review software changes by other developers
• Provide technical guidance to the team on development
• Document the specifications, design, features, and operation of applications prior to production rollout
• Work collaboratively with business partners to define and ensure the completeness and accuracy of system/technical requirements
• Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting
• Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned
• Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation

Requirements:
• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or related field or equivalent work experience
• 0-1 year of professional Java development experience
• Strong grasp of core Java and object-oriented programming: classes, interfaces, inheritance, polymorphism, encapsulation, and exception handling
• Familiarity with the Java Collections Framework, generics, streams, and lambdas
• Understanding of basic data structures and algorithms
• Experience with a build tool (Maven or Gradle) and an IDE (IntelliJ IDEA or Eclipse)
• Proficiency with Git and basic branching and pull request workflows
• Basic knowledge of relational databases and SQL (simple queries, joins, and CRUD operations)
• Ability to read, debug, and explain existing code
• Basic awareness of secure coding practices: input validation, parameterized queries, and no hard-coded credentials
• Ability to use AI coding assistants (such as Claude or GitHub Copilot) for development, debugging, and documentation
• Sound judgment with AI output: you review, test, and understand any code before committing it, and you can explain it in a code review
• Strong organizational, analytical and communication skills (written and verbal)
• Ability to execute project deliverables in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within estimated timelines
• Critical Thinking: Analyze problems objectively and make sound, data-driven decisions
• Attention to Detail: Maintain accuracy across code, data, and deliverables
• Quantitative Skills: Apply strong analytical and statistical methods to solve problems
• Data Interpretation: Extract actionable insights from data, metrics, and visualizations
• Communication: Clearly explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
• Learning Agility: Quickly adopt new tools, technologies, and best practices
• Resilience: Adapt to shifting priorities and deliver under pressure
• Integrity: Handle data responsibly and uphold engineering and ethical standards

Preferred:
• Experience with Spring or Spring Boot (REST controllers, dependency injection, and configuration)
• Experience writing unit tests with JUnit and mocking with Mockito
• Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON, and HTTP fundamentals
• Exposure to JDBC, JPA, or Hibernate
• Basic understanding of concurrency and multithreading
• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, or cloud platforms
• Exposure to Agile and Scrum
• Basic front-end exposure (such as Angular or React)
• Experience writing effective prompts and using AI to generate unit tests, boilerplate, or documentation, and validating the results
• Understanding of AI limitations, including hallucinated APIs, outdated syntax, and insecure suggestions
• Exposure to agentic or CLI-based coding tools
